annotations.title: Add a file to a version

description: Attach a version's working files to a version that already exists (for a NEW upload, pass files with the upload call instead: the version then shows them from the start): ONE zip of the project folder that made it (without node_modules, build output or renders), up to 500 MB. Returns a presigned upload URL for exactly file_size bytes; upload with the curl command from next_step (this needs a shell that can run curl). The zip belongs to the version as soon as the bytes land (no complete call); people see what it holds in the version's Code and Files and download it as <version_id>.zip. A version's zip is set once and never changes: to change the files, upload a new version with its own. Needs full_access (edit access) and membership of the asset's team: any version, not only ones you uploaded.

asset_id.description: The version (an upload's asset_id / version_id), or an asset id (its current version)

file_size.description: Exact size of the local file in bytes (stat -f%z <file> on macOS, stat -c%s <file> on Linux)

name.description: The zip's file name, e.g. source.zip (it must be a .zip)
